source.excerpt: Shared as a portability layer for anyone running enough agents that keeping track of the pieces has become a job of its own.

body:
## What it does

This one exists so a collection of assistants never ends up stranded where it was first built. It keeps a current register of every bot you run, the skills each carries, what it plugs into, what it fires on a timer and how it is reached. Nothing secret is stored, and it works in whichever language you prefer. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @PedroAnibarro shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
